extraction.name: CommonCatalog
extraction.description: A dataset of roughly 70 million open-licensed CC images, for which we use telephoning to generate accompanying high-quality synthetic captions
extraction.creator: Aaron Gokaslan, A. Feder Cooper, Jasmine Collins, Landan Seguin, Austin Jacobson, Mihir Patel, Jonathan Frankle, Cory Stephenson, Volodymyr Kuleshov
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Images were re-scraped from Flickr using IDs from the YFCC100M dataset metadata.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images with non-derivative licenses were excluded, and images were center-cropped and resized to a maximum of 512x512 pixels for captioning.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Synthetic captions were generated for the uncaptioned CC images using a pre-trained BLIP-2 model.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The model underperforms in categories like faces, general photography, and paintings, and the underlying YFCC100M data is about a decade old.

rai:dataCollection.evidence: We began with the YFCC100M dataset, which consists of 100 million CC-licensed images and multimedia files, as well as Flickr IDs linking to the original data [59]... We therefore re-scraped these images from Flickr, based on the IDs provided in the YFCC100M metadata.

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: We exclude images with non-derivative (ND) licenses... we center-cropped and resized all of the images to a maximum size of 512x512 pixels.

rai:dataAnnotationProtocol.evidence: We address the data incompleteness problem by using a pre-trained BLIP-2 model [34], which we use to produce high-quality, synthetic captions for a set of curated, open licensed CC images.

rai:machineAnnotationTools.evidence: chose to use the pre-trained BLIP-2 OPT2.5B model for synthesizing CommonCatalog’s captions

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: It underperformed in several categories, including faces, general photography, and paintings... An issue, which we do not address, is that the YFCC100M data is about a decade old; its CC images are not as current as those in LAION-2B.
